scope: First canonical ATP Earth histories for CZE and DEU, 1955–2026.
principles: All annual values are project-authored derived estimates, never presented as measured tennis facts.
Participation/membership primarily informs popularity and access; it does not automatically set development, competition, elite support or tradition.
Davis Cup outcomes inform competition/tradition context only.
Current talent-centre/high-performance infrastructure informs development and elite support but is not backcast unchanged.
Predecessor-state evidence is explicitly mapped and must not duplicate population or participation across successor countries.
Court count is excluded from pre-alpha.

uncertainty.CZE: Pre-2019 participation/access and pre-2025 development/support are intentionally low confidence; predecessor Czechoslovak outcomes are inherited context only.
uncertainty.DEU: Pre-reunification DTB membership covers West Germany only, so popularity/access for current DEU territory are intentionally conservative; modern development/support is much better evidenced than early history.
